shared.description: Turn your enemies red, white and blue with this weapon! Celebrating Independence Day!
shared.notes:
*Erroneously deals Magic damage type instead of Pierce.
Weapons are animated; a red, white, and blue orb spiral along the blade.
Weapons' special will cause a red, white, or blue outline to appear around the target when activated, respective to the element of the DoT effect applied.
Weapons' special has a 10% chance to activate, thus a special of a specific element effectively has a ~3.33% chance to apply.
Weapons' special may activate multiple times in a single turn, however specials will overwrite one another, and do not stack; only the most recently applied DoT will remain active.

shared.description: Noxus turned your friends to coal. Then you triumphed, made them whole. Let the celebrations begin. It's always better when the good guys win. Falalalala lalalala. Moglin magic gives this dagger a chance to heal you 5% on a successful hit!

levelVariants.name: Dagger of Revelry
levelVariants.stats: Crit +1, END +1, DEX +1

levelVariants.name: Dagger of Festivity
levelVariants.stats: Crit +2, END +2, DEX +2

levelVariants.name: Dagger of Rejoicing
levelVariants.stats: Crit +2, Magic Def +1, Pierce Def +1, Melee Def +1, END +3, DEX +2
levelVariants.description: It is truly a time to rejoice, for your friends have been freed from Noxus cruel, coal-loving grasp. Carry this dagger as a reminder of your victory and enjoy its healing powers: a 5% chance to heal you on a successful hit.

levelVariants.name: Dagger of Delight
levelVariants.stats: Crit +2, DEX +3, Bonus +4
levelVariants.description: This dagger's mirror-bright blade is sure to delight Frostval celebrants old and young. Another reason to celebrate: It has a chance to heal 5% of your life on a successful hit.

levelVariants.name: Dagger of Wonder

levelVariants.description: This Stiletto of Wonder/ has an edge of light. / A blade of healing/ shining bright... Feel free to sing along as you carry this year's Frostval reward into battle in the coming months. It has a chance to heal 5% of your life on a successful hit.

levelVariants.name: Dagger of Amusement
levelVariants.stats: Dodge +1, Crit +4, Magic Def +4, Pierce Def +4, Melee Def +4, WIS +6, END +6, CHA +6, LUK +6, DEX +7, Bonus +5
levelVariants.description: This weapon is a fitting reminder of all the amusement that comes when you have fun and enjoy the little things. It has a chance to heal 5% of your life on a successful hit.

levelVariants.name: Dagger of Kindness
levelVariants.stats: Dodge +2, Crit +6, Magic Def +5, Pierce Def +5, Melee Def +5, WIS +8, END +8, CHA +7, LUK +7, DEX +9, Bonus +8

levelVariants.name: Dagger of Forgiveness

levelVariants.description: Forgiveness is a trait every hero should have no matter how dark the day is. Sometimes those that do the most wrong were themselves wronged the most. It has a chance to heal 5% of your life on a successful hit.

shared.description: This finely crafted dagger was created for a celebration in a far off land.
shared.notes:
Weapons cannot be destroyed.
Weapons' special will cause a red, white, or blue outline to appear around the target when activated, respective to the element of the DoT effect applied.
Weapons' special has a 10% chance to activate, thus a special of a specific element effectively has a ~3.33% chance to apply.
These weapons' specials previously had one active at any time, preventing its DoT effects to not stack; this was changed on October 21st, 2022, where weapons' special now activate multiple times in a single turn, however specials will overwrite one another, and do not stack; only the most recently applied DoT will remain active.
  • All 'Spirit' DoT effects can also be overwritten by the following On-Hit DoT specials from the following weapons; this was implemented on September 8th, 2023:
  • 'DOOM': Corrupt ShadowReaper of Doom, Corrupt Skullstaff of Doom, Corrupt Twin Blades of Doom, Unreal ShadowReaper of Doom, Unreal Skullstaff of Doom, Unreal Twin Blades of Doom
  • 'Destiny': Penultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Penultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Penultimate Twin Blades of Destiny, Ultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Ultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Ultimate Twin Blades of Destiny
  • 'Destroyer's Spirit': Var'Dolaas
  • 'Spirit of Light' (and thus all 'Spirit' effects): Decus, Ferocitas, Fidelitas, Wheel of Greed and Envy

shared.description: When you wish upon a rainbow rock, you never know what will happen!
shared.notes:
Weapons are animated; the colors on the weapon's blade changes repeatedly.
While most versions have the default Light element, I, III and V versions are Water element.
I and IV versions were previously available on the quest To Be A Giant!.
II and V versions were previously available on the quest To Have Famous Friends!.
III and VI versions were previously available on the quest To Have All the Gold In Lore!.
The following changes were implemented on March 13th, 2026:
  • An on-hit effect was added.
  • VII-X versions were added along with the I-VI versions re-release.
  • Items were physically unobtainable until the release of A Tempting Taste on March 21st, 2026.

shared.description: Heroes all over Lore celebrate courage each time they pick up this dagger and sneak into range to attack their enemies. For courage and Lore, chaaaarge!
shared.notes:
Weapons' special will cause a red, white, or blue outline to appear around the target when activated, respective to the element of the DoT effect applied.
Weapons' special has a 10% chance to activate, thus a special of a specific element effectively has a ~3.33% chance to apply.
Weapons' special may activate multiple times in a single turn, however specials will overwrite one another, and do not stack; only the most recently applied DoT will remain active.
  • Weapons' special became mutually exclusive from the following On-Hit DoT specials from the following weapons; this was implemented on September 8th, 2023:
    • 'DOOM': Corrupt ShadowReaper of Doom, Corrupt Skullstaff of Doom, Corrupt Twin Blades of Doom, Unreal ShadowReaper of Doom, Unreal Skullstaff of Doom, Unreal Twin Blades of Doom
    • 'Destiny': Penultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Penultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Penultimate Twin Blades of Destiny, Ultimate Blinding Light of Destiny, Ultimate DragonStaff of Destiny, Ultimate Twin Blades of Destiny
    • 'Destroyer's Spirit': Var'Dolaas
    • 'Spirit of Ice' (and thus all 'Spirit' effects): Brave Blade, Bright Star Staff, Dagger of Unity, Freedom, Independence, Liberty, Mace of the North, Pick of the North, Staff of the North, Staff of Unity, Star Spangled Sword, Sword of Unity, Wheel of Greed and Envy

name: Frozen Dagger
description: Crafted from leftover shards of the Ice Scythe, this dagger will show its true power in the upcoming Fire War.

weaponSpecial.trigger: Activate your weapon's special!
weaponSpecial.effect: Applies 'Strengthen' (+10 Fire Resist) to player for 5 turns inclusive; 1 hit of 100% Ice damage; applies 'Weaken' (-10 Ice Resist) to target for 5 turns inclusive.

notes:
Weapon's special does not stack with Frozen Claymore, Frozen Mace, Frozen Wand, Glaive of Eternal Peace, High-Tech Turducken Carver, Hive Ranger's Halberd, Ice Scythe, or Vanilla Ice Katana's specials.
Weapon is animated; dagger pulses with a bright white glow continuously.
The following changes were implemented on September 8th, 2023:
  • Resist value was reduced from -50 Ice to -10 Ice Resist.
  • Special's cooldown was reduced from 20 to 5.

name: Frozen Kris
description: Forged on an icy mountain top, this blade is imbued with the bitter cold.
notes:
The following changes were implemented on September 5th, 2025:
  • Level was increased from 5 to 9.
  • Damage range was increased from 10-26 to 23-27.
  • Block +2 was removed.
Weapon's price was lowered from 500 to 250 Gold, with its sellback also lowered from 50 to 25 Gold on September 26th, 2025.
